notes: The common Chat composer remains backward-compatible with legacy plain-text draft records and scopes every record by actor generation and conversation.
Reply and edit mode plus target message ID are persisted immediately when the contextual action starts, even before further text input.
Context is restored only after the target appears in an authoritative message snapshot. Reply rejects absent, deleted and local-echo targets; edit additionally requires an owned message.

A target outside the first snapshot can be resolved by loading older messages. Pagination counts newly received numeric message IDs, stops without progress and cannot loop because the accumulated cache already exceeds the page size.
User input cancels a suspended contextual restore; finally always clears isLoadingOlderMessages and the new user text wins.

Successful send and leaving or deleting the conversation clear that conversation draft. Logout and destructive account lifecycle retire the actor generation; an obsolete write cannot overwrite the next session.

The affected browser tests, Android consumer compilation and three exact iOS x64 regressions passed on the Product SHA. A broader iOS class run is preserved as a failed attempt because one unrelated preexisting inbox cursor test timed out.
Independent review returned GO with no P0-P3 findings and confirmed the pagination and cancellation defects from the prior review are fixed.
Attachments, scroll position and unrelated internal state remain transient. This unit does not claim authenticated backend or visual host E2E and does not alter message delivery semantics.
